The '''Glitannai Esplanade canyon''' was a canyon formed from the [[Glitannai Esplanade]] after the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] and [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]] the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] into [[Coruscant/Legends#Yuuzhan'tar|Yuuzhan'tar]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
